app.title: ElmanPOS
common.no_results: Nothing here. Try another search, or add a new one with the button above.
common.name: Name
brand.title: Brands
brand.name: Brand Name
brand.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this brand?
brand.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this brand? Existing products will still reference it.
tax.title: Tax Rates
tax.name: Tax Name
tax.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this tax rate?
tax.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this tax? Categories using it will have no tax until reassigned.
supplier.title: Suppliers
supplier.name: Supplier Name
supplier.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this supplier?
supplier.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this supplier? Existing products and purchases will still reference it.
error.in_use: Can't delete it because other records use it. You can deactivate it instead.
error.invalid_reference: One of the selected items no longer exists (it may have been deleted). Reload the page and pick it again.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check that it is running and try again.
error.duplicate_name: There is already one with that name.
error.duplicate_tax_id: That CUIT is already used by another supplier.
error.name_too_short: The name must have at least 2 characters.
error.invalid_tax_id: Check the CUIT: it must have 11 digits and a valid check digit (e.g. 20-12345678-6).
error.invalid_phone: Check the phone: use at least 8 digits; spaces, dashes, parentheses and a leading + are allowed.
error.invalid_email: Check the email: it must look like name@domain.com.
error.payment_terms_too_long: Payment terms can have up to 120 characters.
category.title: Categories
category.name: Category Name
category.parent_hint: Choose where it goes, e.g. Soaps inside Cleaning. Leave it on "None" for a top-level category.
category.tax_hint: Products in this category use this VAT rate.
category.tax_hint_new: Products in this category use this VAT rate. Choosing where it goes fills in that category's VAT; you can change it.
category.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this category?
category.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this category? It can no longer be picked for new products, but existing ones keep using it.
error.category_parent_invalid: The category chosen in "Inside" is not valid. Pick it again from the list.
error.category_cycle: A category cannot go inside itself or inside one of its subcategories.
error.category_has_active_children: It has active subcategories. Deactivate the subcategories first.
error.category_parent_inactive: The category above it is deactivated. Activate it first.
product.title: Products
product.search: Search by name, code or barcode
common.list_truncated: Showing the first %d of %d. Use the search to find the rest.
product.sku_hint: Set by the system when the product is created. It is not the barcode.
product.name: Product name
product.barcode_hint: Optional. Scan it first: if the product already exists, you are told before filling in the rest. More can be added when editing.
product.barcode_exists: This barcode already belongs to product %s %s.
product.barcode_exists_use: Use that product in the line
product.barcodes_hint: Saved right away, no need to press Save. A product can have several (for example, after a packaging change).
product.barcode_remove_confirm: Remove this barcode from the product?
product.prices_hint: Saved right away, without pressing Save, and effective now. The previous price stays in the history; past sales do not change.
product.prices_empty: This product has no price yet.
product.costs_hint: What it costs you, without VAT. Saved right away, without pressing Save. The previous cost stays in the history.
product.costs_empty: This product has no cost yet.
product.cost_no_margin: This product has a 0 margin: no price is suggested. Change the margin above, in the product.
purchase.title: Purchase reception
purchase.hint: Enter the supplier's invoice or delivery note. On confirm the stock comes in, batches are saved and costs are updated. Costs are without VAT.
purchase.total_hint: The invoice subtotal without VAT. It is compared with the sum of the lines.
picker.product_not_found: No active products with that name or code.
purchase.difference_warning: Saved anyway, but the sum of the lines does not match the typed total: difference of %s. Check the invoice.
purchase.prices_hint: From the new cost and each product's margin. Prices do not change on their own: choose which ones to use.
picker.assign_offer: Add this code to an existing product
picker.assign_title: Add a code to a product
picker.assign_hint: For a product that is already in the catalog without this code (for example, a new presentation). Pick it and the code is saved on the product.
picker.quick_exists: Already in the catalog without this code? Add it to that product
product.category_hint: The product uses this category's VAT.
product.category_new_title: New category (created when the product is saved)
product.category_new_tax_hint: Filled in from the category above. Check it: it is the VAT charged on every sale.
product.supplier_hint: Who to order from when it needs restocking.
product.locked_hint: Once the product has stock movements, sales or purchases, these fields cannot change.
product.controls_batches_hint: For perishables (dairy, cold cuts): stock is kept per batch and the oldest goes out first.
product.shelf_life_hint: How many days it usually lasts from arrival. When a purchase is received, the expiry is prefilled with today + these days. Empty: no prefill.
product.is_consignment_hint: The goods belong to the supplier until sold.
product.reorder_point_hint: Minimum stock: at this quantity or less, the product shows up for restocking.
product.max_stock_hint: Maximum stock: how much it makes sense to buy. Empty for no limit. Must be greater than the minimum.
product.margin_hint: Target profit over the price without VAT. When the cost changes, a price with this margin plus the category VAT is suggested. 0 = no suggestion.
product.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this product?
product.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this product? It stops showing at the register, but stays in reports.
error.duplicate_sku: Another product already has that internal code.
error.barcode_not_digits: A barcode can only contain digits.
error.barcode_too_long: A barcode can have up to 14 digits.
error.barcode_all_zeros: A barcode cannot be all zeros.
error.price_invalid: Price must be a number greater than 0, with up to 2 decimals and no thousands separators (for example, 1750.50).
error.price_product_inactive: The product is inactive: reactivate it to change its price.
error.cost_invalid: The cost must be a number greater than 0, with up to 2 decimals and no thousands separators (for example, 1250.50).
error.cost_product_inactive: The product is inactive: reactivate it to set its cost.
error.purchase_voucher_too_long: The invoice or delivery note number can have up to 60 characters.
error.purchase_total_invalid: The total must be a number of 0 or more, with up to 2 decimals and no thousands separators (for example, 20800.50).
error.purchase_item_product: Choose the product from the list.
error.purchase_quantity_invalid: The quantity must be a number greater than 0, with up to 3 decimals (for example, 2.5).
error.batch_number_too_long: The batch number can have up to 80 characters.
error.expiry_invalid: The expiry date is not valid.
error.supplier_inactive: The supplier is inactive: reactivate it to enter purchases.
error.purchase_product_inactive: The product is inactive: reactivate it to receive it.
error.purchase_composite: It is a combo: it has no stock of its own. Receive the products it is made of.
error.line_product_inactive: The product is inactive: reactivate it to use it here.
error.line_composite: It is a combo: it has no stock of its own. Use the products it is made of.
error.batch_not_allowed: This product does not control batches: leave batch and expiry empty.
error.no_active_store: There is no active store: the stock has nowhere to go.
error.several_active_stores: There is more than one active store and the purchase does not say which one. For now the system works with a single store.
error.barcode_taken: That barcode already belongs to product %s %s.
error.barcode_duplicate: Another product already has that barcode.
error.product_sku_too_long: The internal code can have up to 40 characters.
error.product_description_too_long: The description can have up to 500 characters.
error.product_choice_invalid: One of the chosen values is not valid. Pick it again from the list.
error.product_weight_needs_kg: A product sold by weight is measured in kilograms. Choose "Kilograms" as the stock unit.
error.product_composite_batches: A bundle does not track batches: each product in it tracks its own.
error.product_reorder_point: Minimum stock must be a number from 0, with up to 3 decimals (e.g. 2.5).
error.product_max_stock: Maximum stock must be a number greater than the minimum, with up to 3 decimals. Leave it empty for no limit.
error.product_margin: Margin must be a number from 0 and below 100, with up to 2 decimals.
error.product_shelf_life: Shelf life must be a whole number between 1 and 3650.
error.product_brand_inactive: The chosen brand is deactivated. Pick another or activate it first.
error.brand_exists_inactive: Brand %s already exists, but it is inactive. Activate it in Brands or choose another one.
error.product_category_inactive: The chosen category is deactivated. Pick another or activate it first.
error.product_supplier_inactive: The chosen supplier is deactivated. Pick another or activate it first.
error.product_has_history: This product already has stock movements, sales or purchases: how it is sold, its unit and batch tracking cannot change.
product.brand_hint: Type part of the name and pick it from the list. Leave it empty if it has no brand.
product.brand_inactive_hint: This brand is deactivated. You can keep it or search for another.
product.brand_not_found: No active brands with that name.
product.brand_new_note: New brand: it will be created when the product is saved.
error.product_brand_pick: Pick the brand from the list that appears while typing, or clear the text if it has no brand.
count.title: Stock count
count.hint: Count what is in the store, sector by sector. It also loads the stock that was already there (initial inventory). Only the products you count change: the rest stay as they are.
count.none_title: There is no count in progress
count.none_hint: Start one and count by sectors; you can leave it halfway and continue another day. Nothing changes in the stock until you confirm it.
count.entry_hint: Scan or search the product and type how many there are in this sector (in kg if sold by weight). If the same product is in another sector, add it there too: they add up.
count.discard_confirm: Discard the count? Everything added is deleted. Stock does not change.
error.count_product_missing: Pick a product from the list (or scan it).
error.count_sector_required: Type which sector you are counting.
error.count_sector_too_long: The sector can have up to 60 characters.
error.count_quantity_invalid: The quantity must be a number from 0 up, with up to 3 decimals.
error.count_negative_stock: The adjustment would leave negative stock: the stock went down after it was counted. Count that product again.
error.count_draft_exists: There is already a count in progress.
error.count_not_draft: That count is already confirmed: it cannot change.
count.review_hint: Compare what was counted with what the system says. Only the products that change are listed. If there is extra stock, you can type its cost (before VAT) for the average cost. Nothing changes until you confirm.
count.review_summary: %d products go up, %d go down and %d match the system.
count.no_cost_warning: %d products go up without a cost: they come in at their current average cost, and the average does not change.
count.zero_cost_warning: %d of them never had a cost: they are valued at $0 until one is loaded.
count.review_batches: Extra stock of a product with batches goes to batch %s, with the expiry typed. Missing stock is taken first from the batch that expires first.
count.review_no_changes: Everything counted matches the system: confirming changes no stock.
count.fifo: Taken from the batches (the one that expires first goes first).
count.confirm_ask: Confirm the count? It changes the stock of %d products. It cannot be undone.
count.confirmed_detail: The stock of %d products was adjusted.
adjustment.title: Stock exits
adjustment.hint: Log what leaves the store without being sold: what the family takes, what breaks or expires. That keeps the stock right and, at the next count, the difference left is the unexplained loss. An exit cannot be deleted: a mistake is fixed with a count.
adjustment.notes_hint: Optional; required when the reason is "Other" (say what happened).
adjustment.batch_fifo: Automatic: the one that expires first
adjustment.in_open_count: This product is already counted in the open count. If it left before it was counted, do not log it here: it would be taken out twice.
adjustment.in_open_count_after: That product was already counted in the open count. If it left before it was counted, it was taken out twice: count it again.
adjustment.none: No exit has been logged yet.
error.adjustment_reason_invalid: Pick a reason from the list.
error.adjustment_quantity_invalid: The quantity must be greater than 0, with up to 3 decimals.
error.adjustment_notes_too_long: The note can have up to 500 characters.
error.adjustment_notes_required: With the reason "Other", say in the note what happened.
error.adjustment_batch_invalid: That batch is not one of this product's: pick one from the list.
error.adjustment_not_enough: There is not that much in stock: there is %s.
count.import_title: Import a spreadsheet into the count
count.import_hint: If you counted on a spreadsheet (Excel), load it here: each row is added to the open count as if you had scanned it. Then review and confirm as usual.
count.import_format: In Excel: File → Save as → CSV. The first row must have the column names, in any order:
count.import_format_more: "codigo" (barcode or SKU) and "cantidad" are required; the rest are optional. Rows without a sector use the default sector. Format the code column as text so Excel does not change it.
count.import_summary: %d rows go in and %d have problems.
count.import_problems_hint: Fix them in the spreadsheet and import it again, or add them by hand. The line number is the spreadsheet's.
count.imported: %d rows of the spreadsheet were loaded. Check them in the list.
error.import_missing_column: The first row has no "%s" column.
error.import_too_large: The spreadsheet is larger than 5 MB.
error.import_code_scientific: Excel changed the code (7.79E+12): format the column as text and save again.
error.import_quantity_invalid: The quantity is not a number.
error.import_cost_invalid: The cost is not a number.
error.import_expiry_invalid: The expiry is not a date (2027-03-31 or 31/03/2027).
error.import_code_not_found: No product has that barcode or SKU.
login.title: Log in
error.login_locked: Too many failed attempts. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
cash.title: Cash register
cash.hint: Before selling, open the register with the cash there is to give change. You cannot charge with the register closed.
cash.no_register_title: This store has no cash register yet
cash.no_register_hint: Create the register once. Then open it at the start of the day.
cash.opening_hint: The money in the drawer to give change. It can be 0.
error.cash_opening_invalid: The opening cash must be an amount of 0 or more, with up to 2 decimals.
error.cash_no_register: This store has no cash register yet: create it first.
error.cash_several_registers: There is more than one active register in the store. For now the system works with a single register.
cash.close_hint: At the end of the day. Type what there is for each method: the system compares afterwards and tells you what is over or short. Leave empty what you did not use.
cash.where_CASH: Count the notes and coins in the drawer.
cash.where_cash_float: Include the float you opened with:
cash.where_DEBIT_CARD: Check the debit total on the card terminal's batch close.
cash.where_CREDIT_CARD: Check the credit total on the card terminal's batch close.
cash.where_TRANSFER: Add up today's incoming transfers in online banking or the wallet.
cash.where_QR: Check today's QR payments in the app (Mercado Pago, MODO…).
cash.count_none: No payments with this method today.
cash.close_confirm: Close the register with these amounts?
cash.close_confirm_final: They cannot be changed after closing.
cash.verdict_diff_hint: Check the marked methods: a payment entered with the wrong method, a transfer that has not arrived yet, or a counting mistake.
cash.sales_none: No sales in this register yet.
cash.ticket_of: Ticket of sale No. %d (opens in a new tab)
cash.void_reason_hint: For example: charged twice, the customer did not want it. It is saved. Up to 300 characters.
cash.void_confirm_final: The goods go back to stock and it cannot be undone. Then give the money back to the customer.
error.cash_declared_invalid: type an amount of 0 or more, with up to 2 decimals (for example 15,000 or 1,500.50).
error.void_other_session: Only sales of the open register can be voided. This sale is from a day that was already closed.
error.void_reason_required: Type the reason for the void.
error.void_reason_too_long: The reason can have up to 300 characters.
pos.title: Sell
pos.closed_hint: To charge, first open the register with the opening cash.
pos.scan_no_price: %s has no price: set it in Products to sell it.
pos.charge_hint: Choose how they pay. It can be split; only cash can go over the total (gives change). With the search empty, Enter goes to cash.
pos.leave: There is a sale not charged. Leave anyway?
ticket.title: Receipt
error.sale_register_closed: The register is closed: open it to charge.
error.sale_no_price: has no price. Set it in Products.
error.sale_duplicate_product: The same product is twice in the cart.
error.sale_quantity_invalid: The quantity must be greater than 0, with up to 3 decimals.
error.sale_quantity_not_whole: sold by unit: the quantity must be whole.
error.sale_weight_too_large: the weight is too large. Did you type grams instead of kg?
error.sale_payment_method: The payment method is not valid.
error.sale_payment_amount: A payment amount is badly written.
error.sale_payment_reference: The payment reference is too long.
error.sale_two_cash: There are two cash payments: leave only one.
error.sale_payments_short: The payments do not cover the total.
error.sale_payments_over: Only cash can go over the total: fix the card, transfer or QR amount.
